settings.cursor_shape_about: Draws this shape whatever the program asks for. “Program” follows it.
settings.cursor_blink_about: The cursor of the terminal you are typing in blinks; it stays solid while you type.
settings.cursor_opacity_about: How solid the cursor is drawn, 10% to 100%.
settings.inactive_opacity_about: In a split tab, panes without the keyboard fade toward the background (30% to 100%).
settings.divider_width_about: The gap between split panes, 0 to 16 px.
settings.focus_follows_mouse_about: Moving the pointer over a terminal pane gives it the keyboard.
settings.hide_mouse_about: The pointer disappears when you type and comes back when you move it. macOS only.
settings.confirm_close_running: Ask before closing a running terminal
settings.confirm_close_running_about: Closing a tab or pane with a program or agent running asks first.
settings.shell_about: What new terminals started from the app run. Other machines keep their own.
settings.middle_paste_about: Middle click pastes: the selection on Linux, the clipboard on macOS and Windows.
settings.trim_margin_about: Removes the indent all copied lines share, the gutter agents paint.
settings.notif_bell_about: A terminal that rings its bell (BEL) shows a toast and plays the “needs you” sound.
settings.notif_suppress: Silence what you are looking at
settings.notif_suppress_about: No toast for the terminal in front in the window you are using. Off: they show anyway.
settings.reduce_effects_about: No shadows, frosted glass or translucent terminals. Useful on remote desktops.
settings.app_name: App name in the title bar
settings.app_name_about: Shows “Sunna” in the strip at the top of the window. macOS with the system title bar.
settings.window_limits: Not available: a tray or menu bar icon (the window toolkit has none) and GPU acceleration (the renderer picks it).

settings.mods_guide_intro: A mod is a small piece you add to Sunna's window with JavaScript. Ask your agent to write one, or follow this guide.
settings.mods_guide_where_body: Each mod is a folder inside `mods/` in your Sunna folder, with two files:
settings.mods_guide_json_body: Describes the mod. `place` says where it goes (`none` when a layout or a panel places it), `title` is its name, `panel` makes it an addable sidebar panel and `overlay` gives a popup its width and height.
settings.mods_guide_code_body: Exports a class that extends `View` and draws with `div()` elements from `gpui-kit`. `props()` brings in the data you were given and `run(command, args)` does what a command does. The module that holds these functions is named `herdr`; that name stays so existing mods keep working.
settings.mods_guide_tools_body: Saving a file reloads the mod. `sunna types <mod>` checks its code, and `sunna do <command> [json]` runs any command from a terminal. The full list is in `defaults/AGENTS.md` in your Sunna folder.
settings.mods_guide_share_body: Publish the folder in a GitHub repository and add the topic `sunna-mod`, `sunna-theme` or `sunna-layout`. It will appear in Explore.
settings.agent_hooks_about: Adds hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json so the agents panel and the status bar see working, waiting and idle. Your other hooks stay; a copy is kept once as settings.json.sunna.bak. Unix terminals only.
settings.agent_hooks_unreadable: ~/.claude/settings.json is not valid JSON; fix it first.
